Package hadur2.core.memory

Class Bytes.Writer

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.memory.Bytes.Writer
Enclosing class:
Bytes
static final class Bytes.Writer extends Object
A growable big-endian byte buffer. Values are truncated to the width written.
